svg.title: Every meeting on the way out
svg.desc: Two complete outward offset legs. Rhythms 11 / 6 have 94 ordinary off-axis triples and eleven mirror-axis fourfolds; 11 / 8 have 96 triples and nine fourfolds. Resolving the fourfolds gives 138 and 132 ordinary triples. Each plotted position is one ordered event weight, not an equal increment of offset distance. Gold segments increase strangeness, blue segments decrease it, and lilac diamonds mark cancelling fourfolds. The step counts end at minus 87 and minus 101. Hover an event for its distance and signs. The rational proof covers every nonnegative offset, including the infinite tail.

g.text: Every meeting on the way out.
A complete circle census accounts for both outward legs, at every distance M ≥ 0.
After local resolution: 18 positive + 120 negative = 138 triples
